# A go command passes the org heads it resolved to the go commands it starts. A
# go run under go generate builds those heads and asks the repository for none
# of them. So one go generate builds one set of heads, and resolves each once.
# The child finds them by walking its own ancestors in /proc. No variable or
# flag carries a head, so a host without /proc resolves each head again.

[short] skip 'constructs local git repositories'
[!git] skip

env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=$WORK${/}home${/}gopher${/}.gitconfig
env HOME=$WORK${/}home${/}gopher
env GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=file
env GOPRIVATE=github.com/wow-look-at-my
[!GOOS:windows] exec git config --global 'url.file://'$WORK'/alpha.insteadOf' 'https://github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha'
[GOOS:windows]  exec git config --global 'url.file:///'$WORK'/alpha.insteadOf' 'https://github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha'

env GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Go Gopher'
env GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='gopher@golang.org'
env GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME
env GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL
env GITHUB_ACTIONS=

cd $WORK/alpha
exec git init
env GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-02T03:04:05Z
env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-02T03:04:05Z
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'alpha main'
exec git branch -m main
exec git checkout -b next
cp $WORK${/}alpha-next${/}alpha.go alpha.go
env GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-03T04:05:06Z
env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-03T04:05:06Z
exec git commit -am 'alpha next'
exec git checkout main

# The first directive moves the head of alpha. With /proc, the go run after it
# still builds the head go generate resolved, and nothing resolves it again.
# Without /proc the go run resolves the new head for itself.
cd $WORK/m
go generate
[procfs] stdout '^alpha-main$'
[procfs] ! stdout 'alpha-next'
[procfs] stderr -count=1 'github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha@HEAD: building v0\.0\.0-20260102030405-[0-9a-f]+ -- the branch head, this build resolving it for itself'
[!procfs] stdout '^alpha-next$'

# A go command that no go command started resolves the head for itself.
go run .
stdout '^alpha-next$'

# The environment carries no head. A variable that names one changes nothing.
env GOSMOPOLITAN_ORG_HEADS=github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha@HEAD=v0.0.0-20260102030405-000000000000
go run .
stdout '^alpha-next$'

-- $WORK/home/gopher/.gitconfig --
[user]
	name = Go Gopher
	email = gopher@golang.org
-- $WORK/alpha/go.mod --
module github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha

go 1.21
-- $WORK/alpha/alpha.go --
package alpha

const Name = "alpha-main"
-- $WORK/alpha-next/alpha.go --
package alpha

const Name = "alpha-next"
-- $WORK/m/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.21

require github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha v0.0.0
-- $WORK/m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha"
)

//go:generate git -C ../alpha checkout -q next
//go:generate go run .

func main() {
	fmt.Println(alpha.Name)
}
